name: Account Hacked or Locked
description: Customers report hacked accounts, lockouts, and problems receiving codes or linking accounts.

name: General Account Access Problems
description: Customers describe varied sign-in, account recovery, access, and permission problems.

name: Unexpected Logouts and Reentry
description: Customers are logged out unexpectedly and often cannot get back into their accounts.

name: Login and Password Failures
description: Customers cannot sign in with their credentials, phone numbers, or login links.

name: Phone Signup and Account Access
description: Customers report trouble using phone numbers or social accounts to access existing accounts, sometimes losing saved content.

name: Service Unavailable by Region
description: Customers say the app or signup is unavailable or difficult to use in their country.

name: Basic Features Behind Premium
description: Customers say music playback, downloads, and other expected features require a paid subscription.

name: Payment and Unexpected Charges
description: Customers report rejected payments, billing changes that fail, duplicate or continued charges, and dissatisfaction with costs.

name: General Billing and Monetization Complaints
description: Mixed complaints about payment, restrictions, monetization, and access to music without a specific billing defect.

name: Plan Purchase and Activation Problems
description: Customers describe difficulty choosing, purchasing, activating, or canceling subscription plans and trials.

name: Playback Controls Require Premium
description: Customers say features such as seeking, repeat, shuffle control, and choosing tracks are restricted to Premium.

name: Premium Subscription Too Expensive
description: Customers consider subscription costs and recurring payment for ad-free listening too expensive.

name: Catalog and Music Availability
description: Customers report unavailable songs, missing library items, limited selection, and varied catalog or DJ concerns.

name: Lyrics Missing or Not Loading
description: Customers cannot find lyrics or report that lyrics are missing or fail to load.

name: Missing Songs and Albums
description: Customers report that songs, albums, or other music they want are unavailable or have disappeared.

name: Podcast and Audiobook Access
description: Customers report unavailable, unplayable, or mismatched-language podcasts, alongside complaints about podcast visibility.

name: Recommendations and Discovery Problems
description: Customers find recommendations repetitive or irrelevant and report missing discovery options or alternate track versions.

name: Music Search Problems
description: Customers struggle to search for songs, albums, or artists or receive results that do not match their searches.

name: Downloads and Playlists Disappearing
description: Customers report downloaded music, playlists, or saved songs disappearing or needing to be downloaded again.

name: Downloading Music Problems
description: Customers have trouble downloading songs or playlists, or find downloads slow or unreliable.

name: Downloaded Music Fails Offline
description: Customers cannot reliably play downloaded music without an internet connection.

name: Mixed General App Complaints
description: Mixed generic complaints about the app, updates, and overall experience without a specific defect.

name: Audio Quality and Sound Problems
description: Customers report poor sound quality, low volume, audio interruptions, and difficulty connecting to audio systems.

name: Battery Drain and Slow Performance
description: Customers report excessive battery use, slow loading, lag, and an unresponsive interface.

name: Connection and Offline Status Errors
description: The app reports connection problems or offline status despite available internet, disrupting playback.

name: Crashes and App Won't Open
description: Customers report crashes, black screens, loading problems, and the app closing during use.

name: Playback Device Connection Problems
description: Customers report unreliable connections to cars, speakers, watches, or other devices and unwanted playback switching.

name: Playback Errors and Glitches
description: Customers describe varied playback bugs, error messages, and inconsistent behavior.

name: General Playback Problems
description: Customers report varied problems opening the app or playing music and podcasts.

name: Wrong Songs Play Instead
description: The app plays a different or random song instead of the track customers selected.

name: Playback Stops or Pauses Unexpectedly
description: Music stops, pauses, skips, or ends unexpectedly during playback.

name: Music or Podcasts Won't Play
description: Customers cannot start or continue playing selected songs, playlists, or podcasts.

name: Unresponsive Customer Support
description: Customers report difficulty reaching support, receiving replies, or getting their problems resolved.

name: Too Many Interruptive Ads
description: Customers find frequent, lengthy, or consecutive ads disruptive to listening.

name: Unwanted Autoplay and Queue Changes
description: Customers report unwanted autoplay, added tracks, or missing and changed queue controls.

name: Playback Controls and Widget Issues
description: Customers report missing, difficult-to-use, or unwanted playback controls and notifications.

name: Mixed Usability Complaints
description: Mixed complaints about ads, navigation, playback choice, and app usability without a single specific defect.

name: Playlist and Queue Control Problems
description: Customers report unwanted playlist changes, queue problems, and difficulty choosing or ordering music.

name: Redesign and Interface Changes
description: Customers dislike interface changes and report removed features, harder navigation, or reduced customization.

name: Shuffle and Skip Restrictions
description: Customers report forced shuffle, limited skips, repeated tracks, and difficulty controlling playback order.
